batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: st RV Uthappa b R Sharma

batting.name: M Vijay
batting.dismissal: c AB Dinda b AD Mathews

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b R Sharma

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c M Kartik b AB Dinda

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b A Nehra

balls.text: full-toss and the outside edge goes through the wicket-keeper's gloves for a four! Good way to end the innings for Chennai but a good last over from Nehra.
full-toss and Morkel can only get it up to long-off for a single.
pitching them really full and Bravo taps it away to the off-side for a run. Three runs from four balls.
pitched up on the off-stump and driven to the off-side for a single.
slower one and that is smashed up in the air, but for the second time in three balls, it gets a lot of height but fails to clear the long-on fielder. Well caught by Smith!
on the middle-stump, in the block-hole and flicked away to the leg-side for a run.
gone, caught at long-off! Wide outside the off-stump and the captain went for a big shot, got height and no elevation and he is caught.
outside the off-stump and Dhoni leaves it alone expecting a wide.
pitched on the leg-stump and played away to long-on for a single.
pitched up on the off-stump and Dhoni tries his chopper-shot, but goes only to long-on.
pitched up on the off-stump and that is slashed away for a single.
full-toss and that is wristily flicked away to the deep square-leg region for a four! Good placement to complement an excellent shot.
down the leg-side, 127 km/hr, back to bowling quick and played down to the long-on region for a single.
slower one and Jadeja has mowed it over long-on for a six! Wonder why Samuels even bothers bowling his slower ones when the quicker ones are so difficult to read and hit!
full-toss, 122.3 km/hr, played away by Dhoni to mid-wicket for a single
slightly slower, 100 km/hr, played away to the leg-side for a couple.
pitched up yet again, 127 km/hr, dug out
pitched up, 122.3 km/hr, and driven down to long-on.
pitched up to the bat and Dhoni goes wham at that! But misses and that over costs Pune only four runs!
Oooh! Missed! Needed a direct hit to get that wicket of Jadeja, who had played it to the leg-side to Dinda, but the bowler missed.
goes down the track, gets an edge and goes on the bounce to the wicket-keeper. Then Uthappa throws it back, hits the stumps but Jadeja was just in.
slightly short of a full-toss, driven by Dhoni to extra-cover for a single. Good effort to restrict it to a single by Kartik.
full-toss yet again and Jadeja drives in the same area of the ground, the long-off, where Smith fields and there is a single.
full-toss and Dhoni has bludgeoned it back, bu Smith runs from long-on and prevents the second.
short ball and Jadeja swings the bat at it, takes the top-edge and flies over the wicket-keeper for a four. Nehra is an unhappy man, gesturing his hands around at his captain and the fielders.
outside the off-stump, punched away to the off-side for a single.
pitched in the block-hole and dug out by Dhoni, goes to the left of point, right of third-man and they come back for a couple.
played it to the third-man for a single.
pitching and going to the leg-side and played away for a couple of runs.
outside the off-stump and driven to the long-on, took it from outside the off-stump too.
full-toss and that is magnificently placed by Jadeja! He just punched the full-toss to the left of the sweeper fielder and that goes to the fence!
full-toss, on the leg-stump and driven it to deep square-leg for a run.
right up to the batsman and Jadeja hits it to long-off for a single
outside the off-stump and drilled away to the off-side for a single.
down the leg-side and it is quicker one down the leg-side.
quick down the leg-side and Jadeja tries to work it away, hits the pad.
on the middle stump and Jadeja punches it back to long-on for a single.
outside the off-stump and driven down the ground for a single.
outside the off-stump and played away to the third-man for a single
pitched on middle and punched away to the off-side for a single
down the leg-side, played away to the short fine-leg for a single. Dhoni ran really well from the non-striker's end.
on the middle-stump and punched to short-cover
down the leg-side, a quick delivery and Jadeja does not get any bat on it, wide called.
short of length and that is punched back to the bowler.
full-toss and spanked back for a single to long-off.
driven back to the bowler for no run.
goes down the wicket yet again and this time he has smacked the bowler into the stands over long-on! This was just the third ball he was facing!
goes down the track, turns it into a half volley and he has smashed his second delivery over the bowler for a four. Beats the long-off fielder.
pitched up, on the leg-stump and bit of turn, turned away by Dhoni to mid-wicket.
outside the off-stump, pitched up to the bat and he drives it back to the bowler for a single.
pitched up and still gets bounced, Dhoni awkwardly flicks it back to the bowler.
pitched on the middle-stump and played away to the leg-side for a single.

pitched right up and Raina has timed it well, but not well enough to clear the long-on, Steven Smith stretches high up and plucks it rather easily! He looked good till the time he was at the crease but again departs after a start.
pitched up to the batsman and Dhoni drives on the front-foot for a single.
short of length and Raina late cuts it away for a single.
yorker length on the legs of Raina who flicks it away but does not get the height on it and they get only a single to deep mid-wicket.
another no-ball, this was a slower one, seems to have used up more effort to bowl that slower one! This time Raina gets the strike...can he make it count.
outside the leg-stump and Raina wanted to pull it away, but it comes on quicker and hits Raina's pads.
it was pitched right up to the bat and that is drilled to long-on for a single. Dhoni wanted to send it over long-on.
on the leg-stump and Raina flicks it away to the deep square-leg. Front-foot no-ball, Free Hit coming up.
short of a good length, Dhoni goes down the track and crashes it through the covers for a single.
short ball from Dinda and Dhoni has pulled him away to the left of fine-leg. Nehra did dive but he was nowhere near the ball.
pitched up to the batsman, who carefully drives it to long-off
pitches it up as a change and Dhoni comes out on the front-foot, drives it and that is the end of the first quarter of the game.
short yet again and he had the time to pull it, it came on quicker however, and the pulls goes only to the fielder for a run.
shorter yet again and he gets some more bounce from it, Dhoni punches it off the back-foot for a single.
shorter in length and Raina nudges it away to the deep square region. Raina wanted a second but Dhoni refuses and rightly.
shortish ball, and Dhoni plays a wristy drive to the off-side, sweeper fields.
shorter one and du Plessis tries to use his feet again, there was extra bounce and he seemed to be beaten for pace as well. Uthappa whips off the bails with the batsman well short.
pitched up and drilled down to long-off and they get a single.
pitched up and driven down the ground for a single.
slower on, down the leg-side and du Plessis plays it away to long-on, wanted a second but Raina sends him back.
defended back to the right of the bowler, who was going in the opposite direction and fails to get down to the ball.
shot! Punched away by Raina to the left of extra-cover and beats the long-off fielder. That is supremely well-timed.
outside the off-stump and edged away on the rise, that goes through the lightning quick outfield for a four.
quicker one, more like at more than 120 km/hr and that surprises the batsman, yorks himself!
on the off-stump, played away to the off-side for a single.
pitched right up, quicker one and dug out to mid-off.
straight driven, more like punched to long-on for a single
played away to the off-side for a single.
and then he sends one down the leg-side for a wide!
short of length, turning a little away from the left-hander, punched down the track for a single.
short of length and that is punched back down the ground for a single
slower ball, driven and Ganguly fields again at the short extra-cover region.
short of length and Raina punches it to the short extra-cover fielder.
on the up and he has punched it to the long-off fielder for a single.
outside the off-stump and that has been virtually pushed away to the right of the sweeper fielder for a four! What batting!
flicked away to the leg-side and it is an easy catch to the deep square fielder. Murali Vijay has failed yet again this season.
short of length and the batsman punches it to long-on for a run.
uses his feet again and drives to long-on for a single.
goes down the pitch but defends it back to the bowler for no run.
quicker one again but straying down the leg-side, played away to the deep square-leg for a single.
comes down the track and driven down to long-on.
quicker, on length and defended back to the bowler.
played away to the leg-side, takes a single, retains the strike
uses his feet to a ball pitched right up to the bat and du Plessis has smashed it back to the bowler, who fails to get down in time and it goes between his legs and for a four!
played away to the leg-side for a single
driven neatly to long-off for a single
on his pads and he tries to flick it away. Does not go for the run that Murali Vijay thought there was.
hurries on to the bat, tries to go for a pull, and gets a bottom edge to the pads.
widish again but this time it is pitched right up and the batsman lets it go to the wicket-keeper.
driven and four! That has been sweetly timed through the extra-cover for another four.
would you believe it! Nehra isn't a slow bowler by any stretch and he has been absolutely smacked over his head for a six! Went down the pitch too!
swinging into the batsman and driven to mid-on.
uses his feet, goes down the track and smokes him over the extra-cover region for another four! This is a very confident cricketer at the moment...
outside the off-stump, widish and the batsman goes after it outside the off-stump for a four!
clips away to the leg-side and it goes through the mid-wicket region for a couple of runs.
shimmies down the track and drives him on the leg-side, fielder runs to deep square-leg and they take a couple.
down the leg-side and tries to turn it away. Hits his pads.
pitched up and driven to short cover.
short ball, anticipating him to come down the track and the batsman punches it back down the track.
on the back-foot and defended away to the off-side.
on the middle, short of a good length, punched away to the mid-on region and that is the end of the over.
played away to third-man, opening the face at the last moment and takes a single.
shot, but for nothing! That is driven on the up and a yard either side of the fielder at short cover would have been a four. Goes straight to him.
goes down the track and tries to swing it away, the ball also swung away from the bat and beats du Plessis.
short and pulled away for a six! That came out of nowhere, after all those deliveries defended away by the batsman. It was a tad short and the batsman hit off the front-foot.
outside the off-stump and punched away to the short cover fielder.
pitched up to the bat, driven back to the left of the bowler for no run.
short, down the leg-side and nudged away to deep mid-wicket. First run of the evening.
goes down the wicket, drives through the off-side but straight to point.
on the middle-stump and spins slightly away, defended forward.
tossed up by Kartik, and it is tapped away to the off-side again.
short of length, outside the off-stump, defended away

dropped! Six! What a shot! What a game! Pitched up to the bat and Smith smacks it from the middle of the bat to the sweeper fielder, Ravindra Jadeja, who had to run to his right and he got his hand to it. It was a catch alright, on another day, under other conditions, he would have caught it, this was not his or his team's night though and he tips it over the bar for a six!
horrid, horrid delivery after the kind of field set for him! It was a full-toss and it was on his pads and with the fine-leg up in the circle, it has been flicked away to the fence.
full-toss and he tried to smoke it into the stands. Mistimes it and that takes the edge through to the third-man fielder. 10 needed from the last over.
pitched right up to the bat, and played away to the point fielder, even Ryder is off quickly for a single
another one pitched right up and played away to the off-side for a single. Pune are on top at the moment!
full-toss and that is dug out really well on the off-side through the point region for a four.
on the middle-stump and Smith has whipped it from there and put it to the mid-wicket fence! Another important boundary.
played away to the long-on fielder for a single.
outside the off-stump, goes to scoop it over the fine-leg but misses it! That over keeps the game alive and in balance.
pitched up, walks down the track and almost yorks himself, beaten. That was more than 140 km/hr of speed.
full-pitched and that is edged away to fine third-man for a four! Yes, those were the two boundaries I was speaking of!
full-toss and that is smacked down the ground for a six! They needed it and they have got it, to relieve the pressure for the time being.
up into the block-hole and Ryder isn't able to get under it, taps it to the off side for a run. They need a couple of boundaries here.
another excellent ball to end an over that costs him five. Outside the off-stump, and Ryder went for a drive, misses it.
right up to the batsman and outside the off-stump and drilled to long-off. The throw was to the striker's end, hits the stump and deflects for an overthrow.
pitched up and Smith goes for a slog. He did not get enough on that one and the long-off fielder comes around to field it easily.
slogged away to the leg-side for a single
full-toss and drilled down the ground for a single Ryder's back on strike.
tries to go for a pull and mistimes the shot. Had that hit, it would have gone into the stands. It did not and went nowhere!
missed again on the off-side. Pitched right up to the bat but wider of the off-stump and the batsman swings but does not connect.
shot! Six! It was outside the off-stump and on length, Ryder swung with all his might and that goes over wide long-on for a six!
gives himself room outside off-stump but fails to connect, beats him
worked it over to the leg-side for a couple of runs.
slower one, played away deftly on the off-side for a single.
down the leg-side and that gets the Pune Warriors an extra run
digs out a yorker for a single. Batting maturely here.
driven to long-on for a single
drilled to the extra-cover fielder, who gets his hand to that one, good job done fielding there Murali Vijay
pitched on the middle and Smith tries to unleash the inside-out shot, mistimes but falls short of long-off
cut but not well-timed, goes to the man in the circle
goes down the track, the length was shortened and the ball is played to mid-wicket.
plays it down the long-on region for a single
punched it down the ground for a single
goes for a slog, misses the middle of the bat
drives to mid-on where the fielder is present.
dabbed away to the off-side for a single
he has launched into Raina and smacked it over mid-wicket for a six!
played away to the leg-side for a single
swings in exactly the same fashion as Samuels had done, but this was going above the stumps and Smith survives.
on the middle and played away to the leg-side.
short of length and he tries to pull the ball away, beaten, bowled! It was a slog alright.
on the middle, cutting into the bat and played away to the leg-side for a single.
defended on the off-side, for no run.
short ball and Ryder has swung it away to the mid-wicket region for a four! Half-century to the left-hander off 36 balls
punched off the back-foot for a single to long-off
flicked away to the leg-side for a single
goes down the pitch and drives to mid-on.
punches to the off-side and rushes for a quick single
driven to mid-wicket,does not take a single.
driven to the long-on for a single
good length and that is cut away to the point fence for a four! Big pressure-reliever for the Warriors
cuts away to the off-side for a single
a very big shout, playing it across the line, but the ball was drifting down the leg-side
on the middle-stump, keeping low, and played to the leg-side
punched outside the off-stump for a a couple of runs
defends on the off-side and wants to go for a run, realises the non-striker's reputation and follows it up with a loud shout of 'No!'
driven to long-off to get six singles off the Raina over
cut away on the back-foot and a single taken
goes down the pitch for a drive but gets only a single to long-off
driven to the long-off region for another single
on his pads, and that is flicked away to deep square-leg for a single
driven on the up and a single to the sweeper fielder.
and again, beaten on the outside edge of the bat for a third time in a row, Samuels fails to read that away going ball yet again.
beaten outside the off-stump yet again.
spinning away from the batsman, defended on the front foot.
punched down the ground for a single.

out, run-out! Short and Ryder cuts it away, that was a comfortable single, the fielder at sweeper misfielded and they went for the second run. It was not only a late decision but that was some really slow running from Ganguly even after the decision to take the second was taken.
driven to long-off for a single
quicker one from Raina and Ryder drives it back to the bowler. He needed to dive to his right and stop it from going to long-off for a single. He does exactly that.
played it away to the leg-side for a single
shorter to Ganguly, who wanted to cut it away. Goes to the short third-man fielder for no run.
quicker and punched back to short cover
some turn away from the bat, beaten outside the off-stump
driven to the leg-side but misfielded at mid-wicket
gently taps it to the off-side for a single.
on the middle and Ryder almost walks into driving it to short extra-cover.
shorter from Ashwin and Ganguly punches it to long-off
short and muscled it to the mid-wicket region.
gently nudged away to the leg-side for a single
slows it down really well, Ryder tries to play it inside-out and that goes in the air, but short of long-off
on the middle, driven on the off-side for a single.
jagging back from around the wicket and finally manages to beat the batsman. An appeal from Bravo, but for what, I will never know.
slower one, driven after waiting for an eternity. Finds the gap on the off-side where there were four players guarding the 30-yard circle!
change of line here, bowls on the off-stump and immediately Ganguly pushes it to the off-side for a single
another bouncer, but this is much quicker than the previous one which was a slower one. Ganguly bails out of the hook.
Shortish, almost a bouncer and Ganguly pulls it towards fine-leg. The short fine-leg fielder, Ashwin dives and half-stops it.
bowling way too much on Ganguly's pads after that first ball four, he plays it away for a single yet again.
slightly shorter and that is forced away by Ryder for a single to square-leg.
on Ganguly's pads again, but there is no turn there and that is easily played away.
again on the pads and punched it to the long-on for a single.
darts it on the pads and Ryder is unable to get it away.
on his pads and played away to the leg-side for a single.
again on his pads, but there is fine-leg in place.
again down the leg-side and left alone, wide called. Already 11 off it.
again down the leg-side, but this is slower and does not get too much timing there. Single for Ryder.
tries to dab it through third-man, but goes straight to the short third-man.
poor ball, whether or not the fine-leg is up in the circle, you cannot be bowling on the leg-stump to a player who has smelled blood. Flicks it away for four!
on his pads and played away to fine-leg for a single.
shot! caressed! On the off-side, there is God and the guy next in the list is currently batting! Outside the off-stump and driven gracefully through the covers!

out, run-out! Gently played away to short mid-wicket and they go for a single, wanted to go for the second, a bit of hesitation, but they go for it anyway. The throw is good, next to the stumps and Kulasekara collects it well and dislodges the bail. Third umpire called for and he is found just short!
four more! That is excellent batting from Ryder! Outside the off-stump and Ryder smacks it to the leg-side, the mid-on is a mere spectator.
that is flicked away yet again and this time it it wide of short fine-leg, goes for a four
that is an excellent shot, power-packed punch on the leg-side, to the left of mid-on and right of deep square-leg.
pitched up to the bat and driven to mid-off
lofted down the ground, but not timed too well, the mid-on fielder cleans up.
pitched on a good length, Uthappa walks into it, is beaten, hits the pad, loud appeal, given not-out.
pitched up and Uthappa defends it, and scoots off for a single. Then a poor attempt to run the batsman out gets him an over-throw.
on the off-stump and Ryder moves to the off-stump and punches it to mid-on for a single.
outside the off-stump and it is played down to third-man for a single
punched away over the mid-wicket for a six! Whoa, where did that come from. No swing from Morkel, on the middle-stump and he has smacked him over mid-wicket for a six.
on the off-stump, Uthappa defends on the front-foot and goes straight to point.
pitched up and goes over the top of extra-cover for a couple of runs.
outside the off-stump and that is flayed away without any movement of his feet. Hits the middle of the bat but also goes straight to the fielder in the covers.
short from Kulasekara and that is pulled away, almost whipped away, falls in front of Dwayne Bravo at square-leg.
outside the off-stump and Ryder plays it away to the off-side for nothing.
defended on the back-foot and the batsman is away for a single
down the leg-side, swinging further away and Pune is away with a wide.
